problems.name: CM_PROB_NOT_CONFIGURED
problems.meaning: The device is not configured correctly.
problems.action: Update or reinstall its driver from Device Manager.

problems.name: CM_PROB_DEVLOADER_FAILED
problems.meaning: Windows cannot load the driver for this device.
problems.action: Reinstall the driver from the manufacturer.

problems.name: CM_PROB_OUT_OF_MEMORY
problems.meaning: The driver may be corrupted, or the system is low on memory or other resources.
problems.action: Restart, then reinstall the driver if the code stays.

problems.name: CM_PROB_ENTRY_IS_WRONG_TYPE
problems.meaning: One of the device drivers or the registry might be corrupted.
problems.action: Uninstall the device, then scan for hardware changes.

problems.name: CM_PROB_LACKED_ARBITRATOR
problems.meaning: The driver needs a resource that Windows cannot manage.
problems.action: Update the driver and the system firmware.

problems.name: CM_PROB_BOOT_CONFIG_CONFLICT
problems.meaning: The boot configuration of the device conflicts with other devices.
problems.action: Update the system firmware, or move the card to another slot.

problems.name: CM_PROB_FAILED_FILTER
problems.meaning: A filter driver for the device could not load.
problems.action: Reinstall the driver.

problems.name: CM_PROB_DEVLOADER_NOT_FOUND
problems.meaning: The driver loader for the device is missing.
problems.action: Reinstall the driver.

problems.name: CM_PROB_INVALID_DATA
problems.meaning: The firmware reports the resources of the device incorrectly.
problems.action: Update the system firmware.

problems.name: CM_PROB_FAILED_START
problems.meaning: The device cannot start: a driver in its stack failed to start it.
problems.action: Update the driver, or roll back the last update of it.

problems.name: CM_PROB_LIAR
problems.meaning: The device failed.
problems.action: Reconnect or reseat the device, then reinstall its driver.

problems.name: CM_PROB_NORMAL_CONFLICT
problems.meaning: The device cannot find enough free resources to use.
problems.action: Disable a device it may conflict with, or update the firmware.

problems.name: CM_PROB_NOT_VERIFIED
problems.meaning: Windows cannot verify the resources of the device.
problems.action: Restart, then reinstall the driver.

problems.name: CM_PROB_NEED_RESTART
problems.meaning: The device cannot work properly until the computer restarts.
problems.action: Restart the computer.

problems.name: CM_PROB_REENUMERATION
problems.meaning: The device is not working properly, probably because of a re-enumeration problem.
problems.action: Restart, then reinstall the driver.

problems.name: CM_PROB_PARTIAL_LOG_CONF
problems.meaning: Windows cannot identify all the resources the device uses.
problems.action: Update the driver and the firmware.

problems.name: CM_PROB_UNKNOWN_RESOURCE
problems.meaning: The device asks for a resource type Windows does not know.
problems.action: Update the driver.

problems.name: CM_PROB_REINSTALL
problems.meaning: The drivers of the device must be reinstalled.
problems.action: Uninstall the device, then scan for hardware changes.

problems.name: CM_PROB_REGISTRY
problems.meaning: The configuration of the device in the registry is incomplete or damaged.
problems.action: Uninstall the device and reinstall it.

problems.name: CM_PROB_VXDLDR
problems.meaning: The driver loader failed.
problems.action: Reinstall the driver.

problems.name: CM_PROB_WILL_BE_REMOVED
problems.meaning: Windows is removing the device.
problems.action: Restart, then check whether the device comes back.

problems.name: CM_PROB_DISABLED
problems.meaning: The device is disabled.
problems.action: Enable it in Device Manager if it is needed.

problems.name: CM_PROB_DEVLOADER_NOT_READY
problems.meaning: The driver loader was not ready.
problems.action: Restart, then reinstall the driver.

problems.name: CM_PROB_DEVICE_NOT_THERE
problems.meaning: The device is not present, not working, or does not have all its drivers.
problems.action: Reconnect the device, then reinstall its driver.

problems.name: CM_PROB_MOVED
problems.meaning: Windows is still setting up the device.
problems.action: Restart to finish the setup.

problems.name: CM_PROB_TOO_EARLY
problems.meaning: Windows is still setting up the device.
problems.action: Restart to finish the setup.

problems.name: CM_PROB_NO_VALID_LOG_CONF
problems.meaning: The device has no valid resource configuration.
problems.action: Update the firmware and the driver.

problems.name: CM_PROB_FAILED_INSTALL
problems.meaning: The drivers of the device are not installed.
problems.action: Install the driver from the manufacturer, searching by the hardware identifier shown.

problems.name: CM_PROB_HARDWARE_DISABLED
problems.meaning: The firmware of the device did not give it the resources it needs, so it is disabled.
problems.action: Enable the device in the firmware setup.

problems.name: CM_PROB_CANT_SHARE_IRQ
problems.meaning: The device uses an interrupt another device is using.
problems.action: Update the firmware, or move the card to another slot.

problems.name: CM_PROB_FAILED_ADD
problems.meaning: Windows cannot load the drivers the device requires.
problems.action: Reinstall the driver.

problems.name: CM_PROB_DISABLED_SERVICE
problems.meaning: The driver service of the device is disabled. Another driver may be providing the function.
problems.action: Set the start type of the driver service back, or reinstall the driver.

problems.name: CM_PROB_TRANSLATION_FAILED
problems.meaning: Windows cannot determine which resources the device requires.
problems.action: Update the firmware, or replace the device.

problems.name: CM_PROB_NO_SOFTCONFIG
problems.meaning: Windows cannot determine the settings of the device.
problems.action: Configure the device as its documentation describes.

problems.name: CM_PROB_BIOS_TABLE
problems.meaning: The system firmware does not describe the device well enough to configure it.
problems.action: Update the system firmware.

problems.name: CM_PROB_IRQ_TRANSLATION_FAILED
problems.meaning: The device requests an interrupt type the firmware did not configure.
problems.action: Change the interrupt settings in the firmware setup.

problems.name: CM_PROB_FAILED_DRIVER_ENTRY
problems.meaning: Windows cannot initialize the driver of the device.
problems.action: Reinstall the driver.

problems.name: CM_PROB_DRIVER_FAILED_PRIOR_UNLOAD
problems.meaning: A previous instance of the driver is still in memory.
problems.action: Restart the computer.

problems.name: CM_PROB_DRIVER_FAILED_LOAD
problems.meaning: Windows cannot load the driver: it may be corrupted or missing.
problems.action: Reinstall the driver.

problems.name: CM_PROB_DRIVER_SERVICE_KEY_INVALID
problems.meaning: The service information of the driver in the registry is missing or wrong.
problems.action: Uninstall the device and reinstall it.

problems.name: CM_PROB_LEGACY_SERVICE_NO_DEVICES
problems.meaning: The driver loaded but cannot find its hardware.
problems.action: Reconnect the device, or remove a driver left behind by hardware that is gone.

problems.name: CM_PROB_DUPLICATE_DEVICE
problems.meaning: A duplicate device is already running.
problems.action: Restart the computer.

problems.name: CM_PROB_FAILED_POST_START
problems.meaning: Windows stopped the device because it reported problems.
problems.action: Reconnect the device on another port or cable, then reinstall its driver. A code that returns points at the hardware.

problems.name: CM_PROB_HALTED
problems.meaning: An application or service shut the device down.
problems.action: Restart the computer.

problems.name: CM_PROB_PHANTOM
problems.meaning: The device is not connected to the computer.
problems.action: Nothing to do unless the device should be there.

problems.name: CM_PROB_SYSTEM_SHUTDOWN
problems.meaning: Windows is shutting down.
problems.action: Nothing to do.

problems.name: CM_PROB_HELD_FOR_EJECT
problems.meaning: The device was prepared for safe removal and has not been removed.
problems.action: Unplug it and plug it back in.

problems.name: CM_PROB_DRIVER_BLOCKED
problems.meaning: The driver was blocked from starting because it is known to cause problems with Windows.
problems.action: Get a newer driver from the manufacturer.

problems.name: CM_PROB_REGISTRY_TOO_LARGE
problems.meaning: The system registry hive is too large to start new devices.
problems.action: Remove devices that are no longer used, then restart.

problems.name: CM_PROB_SETPROPERTIES_FAILED
problems.meaning: Windows cannot apply all the properties of the device.
problems.action: Reinstall the driver.

problems.name: CM_PROB_WAITING_ON_DEPENDENCY
problems.meaning: The device is waiting for another device to start.
problems.action: Look for another device with a problem and fix it first.

problems.name: CM_PROB_UNSIGNED_DRIVER
problems.meaning: Windows cannot verify the digital signature of the driver.
problems.action: Install a signed driver from the manufacturer.

problems.name: CM_PROB_USED_BY_DEBUGGER
problems.meaning: The device is reserved for the Windows kernel debugger.
problems.action: Nothing to do unless debugging was not intended.

problems.name: CM_PROB_DEVICE_RESET
problems.meaning: The device failed and is being reset.
problems.action: Wait, then check again. A device that keeps resetting is failing.

hints.note: The device never identified itself: Windows could not read its descriptor. That is a connection or hardware fault far more often than a driver one. Try another port and cable, avoid an unpowered hub, then try the device on another computer.
